# Upstream attribution

The partial source snapshots are attributed and pinned in `SOURCE_MANIFEST.json`. They were inspected for infrastructure and scoring parity; they are not full installations. The original source files and original manifest are unchanged.

Terrarium copyright and MIT permission notice are retained verbatim in `terrarium/LICENSE`, fetched from the same pinned commit; `LICENSE_SUPPLEMENT.json` records the exact blob and byte hashes.

The pinned collusion_hackathon root and colosseum directory listings did not contain a license file. This package does not assign a new license to those upstream files or claim authorship of them.
